ClickHouse 不记录表的创建时间；“最近一次 DDL”取自元数据文件的修: ClickHouse does not record table creation time; "Last DDL" comes from the modification time of the metadata file. Row count / size may be empty for non-MergeTree engines and is not shown. Dictionaries are listed under "Tables".
MongoDB 没有固定 schema：列信息是对集合采样前 100 个文档推断: MongoDB has no fixed schema: the columns are fields inferred from a sample of the first 100 documents of the collection, and fields absent from the sample are not listed; the document count comes from metadata and is not exact. There are no table comments, and creation / modification times are not recorded.
